differences: The board is 10 by 10. The rooks start in the corners, the other pieces on the rank in front of them, and the pawns in front of those.
Each side has an archbishop (a bishop or a knight) and a chancellor (a rook or a knight). There is no castling.
A pawn may promote on any of the last three ranks, and must on the last one. It can only become a piece its side has lost.
